# MagMatrix

> > MagMatrix manufactures fire-resistant, eco-friendly magnesium oxide (MGO) boards for sustainable construction applications.

MagMatrix specializes in innovative MGO board technology that combines fire resistance, structural integrity, and environmental sustainability. Their product line includes sheathing panels, subfloor systems, structural insulated panels (SIPs), and decorative boards certified to meet ASTM and ICC building standards.

## Key Topics

- Magnesium Oxide (MgO)
- Fire-Resistant Boards
- Structural Sheathing
- Non-Combustible Materials
- MGO Boards
- ASTM E84 & E136 Certifications
- ICC Building Code Compliance
- Green Construction
- Moisture-Resistant
- Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs)
- Subfloor Systems
- Fire-Rated Sheathing
- Building Materials
- BMSC 517 Formulation
- Intertek Testing

- [Multi-Support MgO Board for Enhanced Stability](https://www.magmatrixboards.com/multi-support-mgo-board): Multi-Support MgO board for construction with enhanced stability features

- [MAGMATRIX New MGO Sheathing Board: Perseverance Fire Rated Panel](https://www.magmatrixboards.com/magmatrix-magfirepro-sheathing): Perseverance fire-rated sheathing panel with Class A flame spread
- [Multi-Support Fire Rated Sheathing Panel | MagMatrix](https://www.magmatrixboards.com/copy-of-multi-support-mgo-board): Multi-Support fire-rated exterior sheathing board for construction
- [MagMatrix New MGO Board: The Ultimate MgO SIP Panel Solution](https://www.magmatrixboards.com/mgo-sip-panel): MgO structural insulated panels (SIP) for green construction
